reviews.student_rank: Cleared CA Inter with 68 in Law
reviews.title: The 1-on-1 copy checking boosted my score by 22 marks.
reviews.comment: I used to write stories instead of legal answers. The 5-pillar rubric taught me how to cite Bare Act provisions and synthesize facts concisely. The audio feedback note from faculty is fantastic.

reviews.title: Life-saver during the 1.5-day exam gap.
reviews.comment: You cannot read 800 pages before the exam. These LDR maps condensing penalty codes and filing days into 180 visual pages are pure gold. Must-have for every law aspirant.

reviews.title: Full 30/30 in MCQ section thanks to this Question Bank.
reviews.comment: Every single question has explanations for why the other 3 options are incorrect. The integrated case studies gave me the exact confidence needed for the tricky ICAI negative marking traps.

reviews.title: Scored 74 in Law! Volume 1 is unmatched.
reviews.comment: The way Section 96 to 103 are broken down with practical AGM and quorum tables helped me draft crystal clear 6-mark answers. In my exam, 4 descriptive questions were verbatim from Pearl Ma'am's book!
